invariants.rationale: The method always returns the output of the JavaBulkInsertHelper.bulkInsert, which is expected to be a non-null List<WriteStatus>.
numOutputGroups is passed as parallelism for bulk insert and likely must be >0 to make sense for the clustering operation.
inputRecords is passed directly to bulkInsert and is expected to be non-null for the clustering operation.
schema is provided to determine data structure and is passed down to the partitioner.
fileGroupIdList is an input to clustering strategies and is expected to be non-null.
